name: date-picker
useFor: Use DatePicker for one date in a form (a token's expiry, when an automation runs) and DateRangePicker for a period (usage, a log). Control them with value and onValueChange; pass presets for common choices and calendar for disabled days, the first day of the week or today. Give it a label (id) or aria-label; name submits the date as YYYY-MM-DD (a range as nameFrom and nameTo). Built on Base UI Popover and the Calendar item.
constraints: A native date input beside it
A calendar that stays open after a single date is picked
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: the field lines and 14px controls, the nav popup (.hn__panel, .hn__item) and the Calendar item
title: Date picker
description: The square 40px field with a calendar glyph and a caret, opening the calendar in the site's square popup; presets sit in a column of 36px rows beside it, and a range picker shows two months. On a phone the presets row scrolls sideways and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-x).
